profile.Name: Ghost
profile.Personality: Maniacal and proud. He calls himself true valor and scorns Esata, 'the scrambling Golem', as sinking ever lower.
profile.Backstory: Leader of the Berserkers. Once a Shek Kingdom warrior named Suchon, he was exiled in disgrace, and Shek warriors say Suchon died long ago. He now leads the Berserkers from their village east of Last Stand, and the Shek Kingdom wants him as a warmonger. He believes Esata sends outsiders to take his head.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Booming challenges; fights 'for Kral'; scorns 'the scrambling Golem'.
